svg.aria-label: Small rerankers at cheaper shapes · quality against indicative CPU p95
svg.text: Small rerankers at cheaper shapes · quality against indicative CPU p95
Paired change in nDCG@10 against hybrid@bge-small with no reranker (markers, with 95% bootstrap intervals) for each model at depth 5, 10 and 20
and max_length 256 and 512; x is the cell's indicative p95 for one rerank call on one HPC CPU (1024 MiB api limit), not the demo's host.
Dashed verticals: the 1000 ms and 2500 ms band edges; a cell left of an edge can still be in a higher band by its memory peak.
F1 answer (under-indicative-budget cells): NOT SHOWN at this n; F2 answer (with the borderline cells): NOT SHOWN at this n.
indicative p95 of one rerank call on the HPC CPU, seconds (log scale)
larger reference (over budget at every shape)
make figures, from bench/results/small_rerankers_shapes_frontier.json at 475cc85; dashed: the second model of a colour.
